sentences.en: The rambutan is native to tropical regions of Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 这种龙眼原产于东南亚热带地区。

sentences.en: Explorers have just discovered an unspoiled rainforest in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 探险家刚刚在东南亚发现了一片未被破坏的雨林。

sentences.en: The letters ASEAN stand for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
